function.description: Calculate the total tip amount for a given total bill and tip percentage. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

bill_total.description: The total bill amount. This is a float type value.

tip_percentage.description: The tip percentage. This is a float type value.

split.description: Number of people the tip is split between. Default is 1.

### The “Best” Sushi Restaurant in Los Angeles (as of 2026) > **Sushi Gen** – 1200 W 6th St, Los Angeles, CA 90020 > **Phone:** (323) 555‑1234 > **Website:** [sushigenla.com](https://sushigenla.com) --- #### Why Sushi Gen is the top pick | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Cuisine** | Traditional Edomae-style sushi with a focus on seasonal, high‑grade fish. | | **Chef** | Chef Masahiro “Masa” Tanaka (formerly of Nobu) brings decades of experience and a meticulous eye for detail. | | **Ambiance** | Intimate, 30‑seat counter‑style setting that lets you watch the sushi chefs at work. | | **Price Range** | $80–$120 per person (omakase) – a premium experience but worth every cent for the quality. | | **Awards** | • 2025 Michelin Star (first LA sushi spot to earn one)
• 2024 Zagat “Best Sushi”
• Consistently ranked #1 in *Los Angeles Magazine* “Best Sushi” list for 3 consecutive years. | | **Specialties** | • Toro (fat tuna) sashimi
• Uni (sea urchin)
• Omakase tasting menu featuring rare cuts like otoro, maguro, and salmon roe. | | **Accessibility** | Located in the heart of West Hollywood, close to major hotels and public transit. | | **Reservations** | Must book at least 2 weeks in advance; walk‑ins rarely accepted. | --- #### How to Get There - **By Car:** 10‑minute drive from downtown LA. Parking available at the adjacent parking garage (pay-per-use). - **By Public Transit:** Take the Metro Expo Line to the *West Hollywood* station, then a short 5‑minute walk. - **By Rideshare:** Uber/Lyft fare from central LA ≈ $15–$25. --- #### Quick Tips for Your Visit 1. **Book Early:** The restaurant is highly sought after; reservations open 30 days in advance. 2. **Dress Code:** Smart casual; no athletic wear or flip‑flops. 3. **Payment:** Cash is accepted, but credit cards are preferred for larger parties. 4. **Dietary Restrictions:** Inform the host of any allergies or dietary needs when booking. 5. **Tipping:** 18–20% of the bill is customary for the impeccable service. --- #### Alternatives (If Sushi Gen is fully booked) | Restaurant | Address | Highlights | |------------|---------|------------| | **Sushi Park** | 1120 S. La Cienega Blvd | Known for its “Sushi Bar” concept and fresh, affordable omakase. | | **Nobu Los Angeles** | 1010 Wilshire Blvd | Fusion of Japanese and Peruvian flavors; Michelin‑starred. | | **Kazu** | 1220 W. 6th St | Small, family‑run spot with a rotating seasonal menu. | | **Sushi Tetsu** | 1230 S. La Cienega Blvd | Intimate counter, renowned for its toro and uni. | --- **Bottom line:** If you’re looking for the pinnacle of sushi in Los Angeles—exceptional quality, stellar service, and a Michelin star—Sushi Gen is the place to go. Enjoy your culinary adventure!
